{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect data types
print("Data dtypes:")
print(data.dtypes)

# Check if revenue is string
print("Revenue dtype:", data['revenue'].dtype)

# Confirm premises
assert 'loyal' in data['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' not found in customer_segment"
assert 'completed' in data['status'].unique(), "'completed' not found in status"
assert data['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "revenue should be string type"
assert len(data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 QA orders"
assert len(data[data['status'] == 'refunded']) > 0, "Expected refunded orders to exist"

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_float'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders, exclude QA and refunded
loyal_completed = data[
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (data['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output
print("Filtered rows:", len(loyal_completed))
print("Mean revenue (USD):", mean_revenue)"}
